verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows related state-adjacent capabilities—`tofu import` for bringing existing resources into state, refresh-only mode for reconciling state with real infrastructure, and state encryption—but never documents the actual state-surgery commands (e.g., `tofu state mv`, `tofu state rm`, `moved` blocks) that platform engineers use for refactoring resource addresses. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of `state mv`/`state rm`/`moved` block workflows, safety guardrails (backups, dry-run) during state edits, and any hands-on/independent confirmation these operations work reliably.
